ambient_events: The bell over the door settles on its spring.
Something on the bench ticks as it cools.
A radio with its guts open crackles once, catches a bar of old music, loses it again.
description: A cramped, orderly repair shop that smells of flux and oil. Every wall is pegboard, every peg holds a tool worn smooth by a working hand — nothing newer than the last century, nothing that needs the grid to run. A heavy workbench dominates the room, a half-mended pump motor clamped in its vise. A steel door at the back is shut, and does not invite questions. The street lies south.
name: Percussive Maintenance
